testing/property#

Property tests: a condition checked on many generated values, the failing one shrunk to a small example.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Property(origin: IntegerGeneration(minimum: 0, maximum: 1000), seed: 42, cases: 200,
    maximum_size: 100, shrink_limit: 100,
    condition: (n is int) is bool { n + 0 == n; }).check();

Description#

Property tests: a condition checked on many generated values, the failing one shrunk to a small example.

A failure names the seed, case and value, so it can be run again.

Property.Property#

Property(origin is Generation<T>, seed is int, cases is int, maximum_size is int, shrink_limit is int, condition is (T) is bool)

condition over cases values of origin from seed, at most maximum_size, shrinking up to shrink_limit steps; InvalidProperty outside cases 1..10000, size 0..65536, shrink 0..128.
